description.en:
Coldberg maintains strategic deposits of meteorite ore. Sigurd the Swindler's mines has recently been attacked and captured by demons and undead. Sigurd needs your help to free the allod and prevent it from dissolving into the Astral.

Take an Astral ship from Takalik Harbor to get to Coldberg.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 36 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 35 or higher.

description.en:
Rebellious historians' camp has been discovered at one of the distant allods called Avilon. All precautions were taken to secure the ship and the officers, who were going to arrest the historians, but all in vain. The connection with the ship was lost unexpectedly. Your task is to go out there, find out what happened, and accomplish their mission.

Take an Astral ship from your faction's capital harbor to get to Avilon.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 37 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 36 or higher.

description.en:
Strange news was received from the Demon Hunters. One of the warriors, Horn the Roughneck, decapitated the Great Mage Gorluxor - who, as you well remember, happened to had been killed by you back in the Tensess Temple! Go there and find out what really happened to Gorluxor.

Take an Astral ship from Hunters' Camp at Coba Plateau to get to Dragon Ring.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 38 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 37 or higher.

description.en:
Now that's enough! It's time to put an end to Darksoul Scout! Their threatening forces are located at Yazes Shard, where the gloomy Demons' City lies. Unite the forces of League and Empire and strike the legion of the Astral beasts!

Talk to the leader of your faction and use the teleportation scroll to get to Yazes Shard.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 40 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 38 or higher.

Draconids united with Wormfaces on Frontier allod. They pursue some mysterious and horrifying goal. The League and the Empire also join their forces to face the unknown power and to fight against the traitors.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 48 level.

A bloody battle will soon take place in the Dead City. Witness and participate in the birth of a new allod - Cradle! It will open the way to your destination point.
 This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 50 level.

description.en:
It's time for the Great Ball of all Elves! The Great Houses have already gathered on the mysterious Irene, ready to take part in the Great Game - an event that will determine the future of this race. But aside from the Elves, the League and the Empire are also interested in the outcome, because the event can directly affect their own interests.

But these are not the only mysteries of Irene! Those who have been forgotten long ago, those whose names are not even whispered, are also ready to take part in the Great Ball. And who knows what their true goals are?

This adventure is available to all characters of level 88 or higher. We recommend that you complete tasks in this location before finishing the storyline.

description.en:
Additional artifacts are divided into Heroes' Artifacts (they work in adventures), Killers' Artifacts (work in combats). There are three ranks of artifacts, depending on their power.

Heroes' Artifacts can be obtained on astral islands, in the Observatory adventure, and in Nihaz's Citadel.

Killers' Artifacts can be obtained from merchants like the Soldiers of Fortune's Quartermasters, experienced combatants in the faction capital, and Dominion Quartermasters.

Talk to the Relic Master at the capital or the Astral Academy to learn more about additional artifacts.

description.en: Don't miss your opportunity to get your own ship and furrow the most dangerous depths of the Astral! The Buzzing Family on Irdrich will help you start building your ship. To complete this recommendation, fly your ship to the Astral.

description.en:
Skulnar the Fierce is haunted by mysterious visions that show him the end of the world. Help him find an explanation for these gloomy predictions and learn about the danger that threatens all of Sarnaut.

This adventure is available to all characters of level 80 or higher. We recommend completing Skulnar's tasks until you reach level 85.

description.en:
Gates-3 is ready for launch! We need to find Eladia so we can travel to the Mother's world, find allies against Nihaz, and defeat the God of Darkness once and for all! But be careful: the Expedition has already entered this world. It's led by Catherina, Great Mage Felix, and Tycoon Ivan Chelezny. You might have to deal with the consequences of their actions!

This adventure is available to all characters of level 95 or higher. This adventure is recommended to characters of up to level 100.

shortDescription.en:
Gates-3 is ready for launch! We need to find Eladia so we can travel to the Mother's world, find allies against Nihaz, and defeat the God of Darkness once and for all!

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to level 100.

description.en:
The Great Mage Zayan solved the mystery of the amulet found on Irdrich. Its traces lead to the distant allod called Ferris, which seems cold and lifeless at first sight. Nevertheless, its snowy plains conceal many dangerous secrets. It may be even hiding the greatest enemy Sarnaut has ever seen...

Check your mailbox to see Zayan's compelling proposal.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to level 65. Can be accessed by characters of level 60 or higher.

What's the buzz? All brave heroes, thoughtful scientists and reckless adventurers receive mail from the mysterious Director. He's inviting people to take part in a grand show, which will take place at Gipat shard.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 42 level.

description.en:
The world is in danger again. The Great Trees are dying, and who knows what will happen next. The only way to solve this problem is to find Isa, the ancient homeland of the Gibberlings. Learn the intricacies of local conflicts, find out why Isa was hidden from the world, and challenge Fate itself!

This adventure is available to all characters of level 100 or higher. This adventure is recommended to characters of up to level 105.

description.en:
Spiders are gathering in the corners... On the allod Jigran, in the misty city of Dar Ulgorn, the new dark empress reigns: the goddess Hirkalla who is trying to stay in power. Why did the ghosts turn against her? Unravel the tangle of intrigue and find out what force is upon your heels!

This adventure is available to all characters of level 105 or higher. This adventure is recommended to characters of up to level 110.

Through the Group Search system you can easily find a party to instantly set out to an Astral allod. Regular mode is recommended for randomly assembled parties.

Use the Group Search window to enter an Astral allod. To open the Group Search window, press Ctrl+M.

Adventurer's Stone may teleport you to any of the discovered Portal Keepers or to the June Ruins, to which it is bound at the moment. You may find the June Ruins at almost every allod. Come up to them and select "Bind to this location" from the dialog to bind the Adventurer's Stone to them.

description.en:
Nobody really knows what a Distortion is. You can never guess what is waiting for you there, in the timeless space, and what enemies you will have to face. The only sure thing is that the one who stands all the trials of a Distortion will be amply rewarded!

Use the Group Search window (Ctrl+M) to enter a Distortion and complete this recommendation.

description.en: Terrible sandstorms began on Suslanger, exposing the ancient treasures Nezeb had buried in the sand. Take part in this event and get your hands on Nezeb's Great Treasure which contains valuable artifacts and resources.

description.en:
Welcome to Sarnaut! This is your first adventure in the world, full of wonders and mysteries. We will make sure to keep you entertained.

Follow the quest chain of your starting location to get to the capital of your faction and open its main portal (Lightwood Portals for League players, Yasker's Tower for Imperial players, or Howlem Portals for Pridens).

shortDescription.en: Welcome to Sarnaut! This is your first adventure in the world, full of wonders and mysteries. We will make sure to keep you entertained.

In deep secrecy, the construction of Gates-3 started on the deserted Suslanger, but due to a strange Incident, an accident occurred at the facility, cutting it off from the rest of the world.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 95 level.

description.en:
Aidenus and Yasker are concerned with mysterious Klavdia Kalugina's actions. Her power seems to grow day after day. Nobody know what she's after, but her location is spotted. Aidenus or Yasker will give you a quest to follow her, together with fierce Astral pirates. This path will lead you to Umoir, great allod ruled by the proud queen named Catherina.

Talk to Aidenus or Yasker to start the quest.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 60 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 55 or higher.

shortDescription.en:
Aidenus and Yasker are concerned with mysterious Klavdia Kalugina's actions. Her power seems to grow day after day. Nobody know what she's after, but her location is spotted. The pursuit will lead you to Umoir, great allod ruled by the proud queen named Catherina.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 60 level.

description.en:
It has been two years of war for the Holy Land between the League and the Empire. In this very land lies the Spark of the great mage Tensess. Yasker and Aidenus are calling up to their soldiers to go to Asee-Teph and achieve the victory!

Take an Astral ship from your faction's capital harbor to get to the Holy Land.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 27 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 23 or higher.

description.en:
Something sinister is happening in the lands of the Free Traders. The Demon Hunters, who protect their allod from the Astral monsters, ask for help from both the League and the Empire. They cannot hold off the onslaught of the mysterious enemy on their own.

We need to lend a hand to the defenders of Sarnaut... And prepare for the biggest war in history.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to level 70.

shortDescription.en:
The Demon Hunters, who protect Dane from the Astral monsters, ask for help from both the League and the Empire. They were attacked by a mysterious enemy, and they cannot hold off the onslaught on their own. We need to lend a hand to our old allies... And prepare for the biggest war in history.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to level 70.

description.en:
Something strange is happening at the epicenter of the explosion that went off during the battle between Sarn and the Architect. Now that the Astral Storm has finally abated, both the League and the Empire are hurriedly dispatching expeditions to the site of the battle in hopes of discovering something that will give them an upper hand in this never-ending war.

In the meantime, Astral Demons have become active again. There are rumors that they have gone crazy after the death of their master - they even attack each other. Whatever awaits heroes in the Far Astral, it cannot be good...

This adventure is recommended for characters of up to level 75.

shortDescription.en:
Something mysterious is going on at the site of the explosion which fired during the battle of Sarn and the Architect. Now when the Astral storm has eased off, the League and the Empire are hurriedly organizing expeditions to the battleground, hoping to find anything that can help them in their endless war.

This adventure is recommended for characters of level 75 and higher.

description.en:
Call for help comes from a surprising direction this time. Nefer Ur together with the Aoidoi want to help the residents of the Sogot allod. Everyone on this allod is either a demon or a mage renegade who studies Demonology.

This adventure is recommended for characters of level 80 and higher.

description.en:
You will be taken to Eljune, where the auction sale of the Holy Weapon will take place. Both League and Empire are willing to grab hold of it! You will help your faction win the auction and fight the Shadow, that is coming from the West and drives crazy local citizens and animals.

Go to the Western border of Asee-Teph and cross the Bloody outpost to get to Eljune.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 31 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 27 or higher.

description.en:
Coba Plateau is a zone, full of strange anomalies and ancient mysteries. You are going there to deal with the cursed artifacts. Local Prospectors and the Goblin mafia are already fighting for them. You are going to put an end to Shadow relics traffic, before whole Sarnaut us under the threat.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 35 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 31 or higher.

shortDescription.en:

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 35 level.

What's the point in watching the history go by, if you cannot take part in the action? This is the belief of Gorislav Gipitsky, who is offering you to join an astonishing adventure. You will visit the past and turn awry the currents of action.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 45 level.

description.en:
Tep Cultist are active once again and kidnapping people at all allods. The League and the Empire are uniting their forces to fight Tep on his grounds, but they lose contact with the ships that have been sent off. The two faction are nearly at one another's throat, so you will have to interfere and put an end to the crazy necromancer once and for all.

Marianne de Ardeur or Elizaveta Rysina will help you. Do not forget to check your mail!

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 55 level. Can be accessed by characters of level 50 or higher.

shortDescription.en:
Tep Cultist are active once again and kidnapping people at all allods. The League and the Empire are uniting their forces to fight Tep on his grounds. Visit Irdrich, a beautiful allods in the depths of the Astral.

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 55 level.

description.en:
You may explore the locations of your faction once you complete your starting adventure. Wander about your mother allod, face the dangerous enemies, investigate what is going on there. Your deed won't remain unnoticed!

Meet new people and thoroughly study what the game has to offer to really enjoy it!

This adventure is recommended to characters of up to 23 level.

description.en: One of the battles with Nihaz's supplementary rules.

Witch's Hollow is a two-team battle for the control over the area.

You need to capture and hold three banners - near the old Zem Pyramid, the Lumber Mill, and the Mill. Your team scores points for each captured banner, and team members resurrect next to the team's banner after they die.

The first team to score 2,500 points wins.
Here you can participate in combats in practice mode, which will not affect your rating.

Training Camp is a two-team battle for the control over a cutting-edge combat Golem.

Your objective is to capture the Golem in the enemy's laboratory and guard your own Golem from being stolen by the enemies.

The player who controls the Golem is unable to use any abilities and is bound to rely on the team's protection.

To score winning points, the team has to get the enemy Golem across to their laboratory while its own Golem is not controlled by the enemy team.

The first team to score 2,500 points wins.

Battle for Cargallas is a multi-mode combat activity.

Game mode is selected randomly in the beginning of the battle:

1. Checkpoint Capture. Your aim is to capture most strategic checkpoints to score maximum points.

2. Flag Capture. Your aim is to capture the Flag in the center of the map and carry it through all your team's checkpoints.

3. Death Mark. One random player from each team receives a Death Mark. Your aim is to protect your marked ally and kill the marked enemy team member.

Old Fortress is a two-team battle for control over the area.

You need to capture and hold three banners - inside the Fortress, the Battlefield, and the Farm. Your team scores points for each captured banner, and team members resurrect next to the team's banner after they die.

The first team to score 2,500 points wins.
Goblinball is a traditional Orcish game that gained popularity both in the Empire and in the League. Two teams fight hard to score the goal, and whoever is the first to do so, wins!

With the secret drawings of ancient June mechanisms and Master's designs, Zem scientists could not think of anything else but strengthening their military power. Their laboratories came up with more and more advanced mortiferous inventions: light and fast Fireflies, IS-7 Heavy tanks, far-distance T92 Arty cannons, and multipurpose Maus, which was immediately recognized as a true military masterpiece. It was decided to put Maus to service tests in the Summerhold, a village that was abandoned long ago.

Everything ran to plan: the earth was trembling, the targets were torn to pieces, the combatants celebrated the triumph of the Empire... No one noticed that a goblin technician, whose only duty was to polish the turret of Maus during test breaks, had fallen into the control cabin hatch. Who ever would have thought that Maus was designed with a goblin-friendly operation panel! With this incredible killing machine under his command, goblin started fighting for freedom and independence of his race.

Maus revolted against its creators. Scientists and militants were unable to stop it and fled from the Summerhold in panic. Now only the bravest heroes of Sarnaut dare to set face against the horrible machine of destruction!

Witch's Hollow is a two-team battle for the control over the area.

The teams are assembled randomly in the beginning of the battle.

You need to capture and hold three banners - near the old Zem Pyramid, the Lumber Mill, and the Mill. Your team scores points for each captured banner, and team members resurrect next to the team's banner after they die.

The first team to score 2,500 points wins.

Training Camp is a two-team battle for the control over a cutting-edge combat Golem.

The teams are assembled randomly in the beginning of the battle.

Your objective is to capture the Golem in the enemy's laboratory and guard your own Golem from being stolen by the enemies.

The player who controls the Golem is unable to use any abilities and is bound to rely on the team's protection.

To score winning points, the team has to get the enemy Golem across to their laboratory while its own Golem is not controlled by the enemy team.

The first team to score 2,500 points wins.
